## 0. loading data and description

```{r, echo=TRUE}
d <- read.csv2("bank.csv")
d$duration <- NULL
names(d)

```

Do not use `duration` because at prediction time (before the call ends) you don’t know it.

Observe class imbalance:

```{r, echo=TRUE}
table(d$y)
prop.table(table(d$y))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
set.seed(69)
n <- nrow(d)
train <- sample(seq_len(n), size = round(0.7 * n))
test  <- setdiff(seq_len(n), train)

d_train <- d[train, ]
d_test  <- d[test, ]

```
